leaves.formula: POP_CAND := |{c : death_reason=RESET_HTF}| = 1442; POP_EDGE := |{bars : L3 transition SWEEP→RANGE}| = 1372; POP_CAND ≠ POP_EDGE; use POP_CAND for death-share; use POP_EDGE for SM-edge only

leaves.question: Does 80.2% RESET_HTF prove the clock path is wrong?
leaves.formula: MECH := P(death_reason=RESET_HTF) = 0.802; OUT := Δ(expectancy | REPLACE_CLOCK→BREAK); MECH ⇏ OUT; OUT requires CF_RECORDED

leaves.question: How do candle_idx / candle_index / bar_idx align for this run?
leaves.formula: bar_idx(open_ts) = trades.candle_idx − 1; bar_idx(open_ts) = events.candle_index + 62; trades.candle_idx = events.candle_index + 63; join preferred on bar_ts / opened_at

leaves.question: What is the true state order for bottleneck labeling?
